name: X3: fix the 11 known test failures
description: Fixes the 10 failures in scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts and the 1 in web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx so that npm test is fully green on the merged branch.

userStories.title: Diagnose the 11 failures
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want each failure explained so that the fixes target causes.
steps: Run npx vitest run scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx and read every failure.
Write the cause of each failure in notes (one line each) and group them.
acceptanceCriteria: notes lists all failing tests with a one-line cause each
No test file was edited in this story (git diff --stat on the two test files is empty)

userStories.title: Fix the docs preflight failures
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts green so that the submission check passes.
steps: Fix each failure from US-001 in scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts: update stale docs under docs/ or the paths the test reads.
Re-run npx vitest run scripts/preflight and confirm the rest of that folder still passes.
acceptanceCriteria: No assertion was deleted or loosened: git diff on scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts shows each change explained in notes

userStories.title: Fix the authoring agreement failure
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx green so that authoring and the schema agree.
steps: Fix the one failing test in web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx at its cause (see US-001 notes).
Re-run npx vitest run web/src and confirm no other web test regressed.
acceptanceCriteria: The change keeps the test's assertion meaning (explained in notes)

userStories.title: Full run
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the whole suite green so that every later PRD can trust npm test.
steps: Run npm run typecheck, npm run lint and npm test.
If any test still fails, fix its cause and re-run the full gate until it is green.
acceptanceCriteria: npm test passes with zero failures
npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass

readFirst: scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts and the docs or files it checks
the output of: npx vitest run scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx
metadata.standingRule: Engine PRD. Everything is offline and free: unit tests in vitest (jsdom project) and browser checks on the engine lab pages. The director app is not changed.
guardrails: Work offline. The only network use allowed is `npm install`. Tests never fetch; use the stored films under data/films/*/versions/*.json (read with node:fs) and assets under web/public.
Never commit, push, tag, publish to npm, deploy or change repository settings. autoCommit is off and the owner commits.

Read engine/docs/10-aep-adapter.md and engine/docs/README.md before writing code. The spec is the contract: if it is wrong or impossible, do the closest thing that works and explain the difference in notes.
The app's composition format is AepCompositionJson from `@shared/aep` (our own copy of the schema). Never import `reacthub-pixitweenjs`, `pixi.js`, `@pixi/*` or `pixi-filters` in new code.

Use the engine through `@engine/*` (engine/src). Do not edit engine/ except the files in metadata.sharedEdits; if the engine lacks something, add a row to docs/todos/ENGINE-NEEDS.md, use a workaround and say so in notes.
Edit only the files the story names, their tests, and metadata.sharedEdits. Do not change server/ behaviour, agent prompts or stored films.
No `@ts-nocheck` and no `@ts-ignore`. `@ts-expect-error` only with a reason on the same line.
jsdom has no 2D canvas context and no WebGL: unit-test pure logic; check drawing in the browser. Never weaken a test to make it pass.

Debug output and screenshots go to debug/app/ (gitignored). For a browser check use the dev server on http://localhost:5173 (already running; do not start another); headless Chromium through @playwright/test is fine.
Record only real results. Never invent measurements or test output.

`npm test` has 11 known failures outside your files (10 in scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts, 1 in web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx). Do not edit those files. The `npm test` gate passes when no other test fails.

The dev server on http://localhost:5173 is owner-run and shared: never kill, restart or stop it (no kill/pkill/lsof-kill on vite or port 5173). If it is down, use headless Chromium against `npx vite --config web/vite.config.ts --port 5180 --strictPort` started and stopped by you, and only that one.

EXCEPTION to the rule above, for this PRD only: you MAY edit scripts/preflight/docs.test.ts and web/src/authoring-agreement.test.tsx. Fix the cause (a stale doc, a renamed file, a changed schema) rather than weakening an assertion; if an assertion checks something that no longer exists on purpose (for example the removed library), update it to the new truth and say why in notes.

ui: Verify in the browser: with the dev server on http://localhost:5173 (owner-run; else `npm run engine:e2e` once it exists), open the page named in the story, confirm the stated behaviour, save a screenshot to debug/engine/, and record what you saw in `notes`
